archers.label: Archer
archers.source: Owner-provided ARP soldier and six FBX clips; tools/units3d/archer_arp/. Equipment exported separately and assembled in scenes/models/units/archers.tscn.

weights.body: corrected ARP skin, all six influences retained
weights.equipment: named skin binds; bow string sampled to DEF-string

axemen.label: Axeman
axemen.source: The infantry's Tripo soldier with the owner's hand axe and round shield, rigged with Auto-Rig Pro and driven by the owner's Mixamo sword-and-shield clips with the axe grip and the authored chop (ATTACK): assets/3D/model_wip/blender_output/infantry/infantry_handaxe_shield.blend (git-ignored), tools/units3d/infantry_arp/game_export.py ARM axemen; PIVOT_RIGHT / PIVOT_LEFT baked by tools/units3d/soldier_arp/pivot.py
axemen.weights: ARP skin limited to 4 influences; hand axe and shield rigid on cc_weapon.r / cc_weapon.l

cavalry.label: Knight
cavalry.source: Tripo 3D (owner, paid plan) heavy knight rigged with Auto-Rig Pro on the ARP armoured horse, a 2.7 m spear; clips authored in assets/3D/model_wip/blender_output/heavy_cavalry/rider_clips.blend, installed by tools/units3d/cavalry_arp/game_export.py (decimated by the blender-decimate-quality skill)

weights.horse: ARP horse bind (the horse pipeline's weights.sh)
weights.rider: ARP bind, plates rigid per piece (k2)

courier.label: Courier
courier.source: Tripo 3D (owner), from zimage_C4_s2, modelled by tools/units3d/courier_build.py; re-rigged and re-animated by the blender-auto-rig / blender-natural-animation phases in tools/units3d/courier_rig/ (installed by its install.py)

heavy_infantry.label: Heavy man-at-arms
heavy_infantry.source: The owner's Tripo plate soldier (heavy_infantry_parts.glb, 79 parts, decimated per part 53,269 -> 11,410 tris with maps baked from the high mesh) with the infantry's short sword and round shield, rigged with Auto-Rig Pro and driven by the infantry's clips: assets/3D/model_wip/blender_output/heavy_infantry_parts/hip_shortsword_shield.blend (git-ignored), tools/units3d/infantry_arp/game_export.py ARM heavy_infantry; PIVOT_RIGHT / PIVOT_LEFT baked by tools/units3d/soldier_arp/pivot.py
heavy_infantry.weights: ARP skin limited to 4 influences; sword and shield rigid on cc_weapon.r / cc_weapon.l

infantry.label: Man-at-arms
infantry.source: The no-rig Tripo soldier (infantry-no-rigging.glb) with a short sword and a round shield, rigged with Auto-Rig Pro and driven by the owner's Mixamo sword-and-shield clips: assets/3D/model_wip/blender_output/infantry/infantry_shortsword_shield.blend (git-ignored), tools/units3d/infantry_arp/game_export.py; PIVOT_RIGHT / PIVOT_LEFT baked by tools/units3d/soldier_arp/pivot.py
infantry.weights: ARP heat-map skin, legs split below the hem; sword and shield rigid on cc_weapon.r / cc_weapon.l

royal.label: King
royal.source: Tripo 3D (owner, paid plan) from royal/model_wip/tripo/REF_royal_qwenfast_s1.png; rigged and animated by the owner (knight_rig_anim.blend); tools/units3d/royal_install/ decimate.py (90,506 -> 19,998 tris)

militia.label: Town militia
militia.source: The parts Tripo militiaman (tripo_inbox soldier/militia_parts.glb) with the infantry's short sword and round shield, rigged with Auto-Rig Pro and driven by the infantry's ten clips and its seven duel clips (BLOCK..BLOCK_4, HIT..HIT_3; no DEATH yet) at a narrower stance: assets/3D/model_wip/blender_output/militia/militia_parts_12_duel.blend (git-ignored), tools/units3d/militia_arp/game_export.py. The militia arm's piece (army_models.tres militia), also worn by a raised town militia (its roster row's figure).
militia.weights: ARP skin limited to 4, the knee-length skirt on 10 chains of 3 bones whose keys are baked into every clip; sword and shield rigid on cc_weapon.r / cc_weapon.l

commander.label: Commander
commander.source: Tripo 3D (owner, paid plan) parts commander rigged with Auto-Rig Pro on the heavy cavalry's ARP armoured horse, carrying a banner whose cloth takes a realm's flag; clips authored in assets/3D/model_wip/blender_output/units/commander/cmd_rider_clips.blend (decimated there by the blender-decimate-quality skill), installed by tools/units3d/commander_arp/game_export.py

weights.horse: ARP horse bind (the horse pipeline's weights.sh)
weights.rider: ARP bind, right arm mirrored from the left, head parts rigid
weights.banner: staff rigid on cc_weapon.r, cloth on flag_1..6
